audit_items.proof_trace: Neither `ObligationHotPotato` nor `return_obligation` exist in the codebase; the property describes a design pattern that was not implemented. Obligations are stored permanently in `Market.obligations: ObjectTable<ID, Obligation<MarketType>>` and never extracted, so no hot potato is needed to force return. Each borrow/withdraw operation atomically calls `is_obligation_safe` (handle_borrow:L424-434, handle_withdraw:L332-342) before completing, providing equivalent safety guarantees. The actual hot potato in scope (`FlashLoan` with no abilities, market.move:L39-42) is correctly enforced — it must be consumed by `repay_flash_loan` in the same PTB.
